decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API is close to the core messaging offer and has had its own web page across two years, so it is embedded in the firm's visible cloud communications direction and costs little to keep, with no evidence of results that cannot be explained by temporary causes.

The email-to-SMS gateway was launched only in 2024 on the existing messaging platform and is publicly presented on its own page, so weak early results can still be read as ramp-up and dropping it would contradict the announced integrated-channel strategy.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B within the firm's integrated communication portfolio, was launched recently with visible public commitment, and is cheap to maintain on shared infrastructure, so management would persist with it rather than write it off.
